en.<p class=\"eyebrow\">Adapter Sleeve</p>:
Adapter Sleeve

Adapter Sleeves for Rolling Bearings

A sleeve used to mount a tapered-bore bearing onto a cylindrical shaft. Its outer surface is machined to a 1/12 taper, so pushing it in with a lock nut tightens the bore, securing it firmly onto the shaft.

en.<strong>계열 안내</strong><br> 어댑터슬리브 계열은 H2:
About the Series
There are five adapter sleeve series — H2, H3, H23, H30, and H31 — of which only the three most commonly used, A2, A3, and A23, are listed in the table. The only difference between series is L (overall length); all other dimensions are identical.
